biotools.summary: Sassy is a high-performance tool designed for multiple approximate string matching (MASM) of short DNA patterns. It accelerates batch searching of patterns like barcodes, primers, or CRISPR spacers within large sequencing reads or genomes using specialized SIMD hardware optimization.
